title: Example 142: ASCII fast path of ModifiedUtf8#encodeInto proved equal by the own checker with path merging
description: Runs build.py on example 142 (B9, approach.engine native): the regression proof of Mica's ModifiedUtf8#encodeInto with an ASCII fast path against the previous version, at the default bounds (8 elements, unwind 16), by the tool's own checker with paths merged at join points. Expected: verified, in about 6 s and under 100 MB (237 paths). This is the proof that waited in examples/apps/mica/pending for a larger machine, since JBMC ran out of memory at 2.8 GB on it.
